effects.effect: Your god blesses you with the ability to stretch your divine magic farther. You have a +2 [bonus](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/bonuses-and-penalties) to the [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) magic abilities.
